description: This file defines an AppRouter class responsible for managing route generation in a Flutter application. It handles static routes like '/lock' and '/home', as well as dynamic routes such as '/folder/:id' and '/doc/:id', extracting IDs from either path segments or arguments. Placeholder screens are included for various routes, and the routing logic gracefully falls back to an error screen or home page as needed.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Contains static method for route generation handling static and dynamic routes with ID extraction logic.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Generates routes based on the provided RouteSettings, handling static and dynamic patterns.

methods.name: _tryMatchWithId
methods.description: Matches paths with '/folder/' or '/doc/' prefixes and returns the ID segment.

methods.name: _extractId
methods.description: Extracts an integer ID from route arguments or path segment.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Creates an error route with a message.

classes.name: _LockScreen
classes.description: Placeholder screen for the lock/authentication page.

classes.name: _HomeScreen
classes.description: Placeholder screen representing the home page with folders overview.

classes.name: _FolderScreen
classes.description: Screen displaying a specific folder identified by ID.

classes.name: _DocumentScreen
classes.description: Screen displaying a specific document identified by ID.

classes.name: _ErrorScreen
classes.description: Screen to display routing errors with a message.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Main route generator handling static and dynamic routes, with ID extraction and fallback.

methods.name: _tryMatchWithId
methods.description: Matches path segments with prefix for folder or document routes, returning ID string if match.

methods.name: _extractId
methods.description: Attempts to parse an ID from route arguments or path segment string.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Creates a route leading to an error display with a message.
